name: Werebear
summary: The Infernal City, Skyrim(DB), ESO Werebears (or were-bears)[2]:Part 3, Chapter 7 are large werebeasts which possess bear-like features.[3][4] They are claimed to be the most common lycanthropes of Skyrim,[3] though they are rarely actually seen.[5][3][6] It is said werebears can also be found in the northern parts of High Rock, Cyrodiil, and Morrowind.[3] In the Fourth Era, hunting packs of werebears could be more commonly encountered on the island of Solstheim.[4] Werebears are sometimes considered to be more dangerous than werewolves,[7][1] they have even came into conflict with or wiped out werewolf packs.[8] Werebears are known to have a taste for honey,[4] and will even attack travelers to steal it.[9] Werebears are a common subject of tales and folklore in Nordic culture,[5][10][11] despite the lack of documented encounters.[5][3] One Legend holds that smearing canis root on the trees surrounding one's home wards off werebears.[3][7][5] The Skaal consider true bears noble and great creatures of the All-Maker, but lycanthropes like werebears are considered defilements of the All-Maker's workings.[12] Despite this, the Beast Stone of the All-Maker has been known to grant individuals with the ability to summon a werebear.[13] "Lucky Werebear Paws" are a type of strange magical curiosity. They are still "living" severed werebear paws that can be used a pocket warmers as long as their paws are kept trimmed.[14]
